name: Pure 100% Ground Sesame Tahini (Silky Smooth Paste)
whyItWorks: Made from 100% hulled sesame seeds stone-ground into a silky liquid butter. Because the seeds are completely pulverized into a liquid emulsion, there are zero abrasive whole seeds, delivering rich plant calcium, iron, and healthy fats safely.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Whisk 1 tablespoon with warm water, sea salt, and a drop of maple syrup for a rich, dairy-free sauce over rice and chicken.
watchOuts: High in natural plant fats; stick to 1 tablespoon servings to prevent rapid transit.
